trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then activities, then collectibles — and check the missables before the final mission, since some may not be available afterwards.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of the game, so this trophy comes naturally in the first hour. Play through the introduction and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions and this pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep following the main missions in order; the chapter ends and the trophy unlocks with it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play the main missions through to the chapter's end — no side work is needed for this one.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The last chapter before the finale — finish its missions and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. It is the last story mission, so finish the story to earn it — and make sure the four missables are done first, since some may not be available afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions appear in order; play the main path and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist — follow the main missions until it appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story in order; the mission unlocks when the plot reaches it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission like the rest — play the main path until it appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport takedown comes in the story's order — play through until it shows up.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Another story mission in sequence — finish it and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion: every mission, activity, collectible and challenge the game counts. This is the long one — use the checklist here to track what is left, and save it for last, after the story and the missables.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; completion list via PSNProfiles. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts count whenever you pull one off — jumps, near misses, long air time — so they stack up naturally across the whole game; if you are short at the end, chain jumps off ramps and highway crests.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; target count via PSNProfiles. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races, meditation, bowling, darts or pool, and one more — so sample one of each rather than grinding one.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; activity count via PSNProfiles. The exact list of the 9 types is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's challenges one at a time; gold rewards accuracy and speed together, so practise slow aimed shots before chasing the clock.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 42-challenge count via PSNProfiles. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations — win one race at each, learning each course's gates before pushing for speed.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 14-location count via PSNProfiles. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, so enter the ones you are best at and work through 20 distinct events rather than repeating the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal, watch his rhythm, and out-fish him — steady reeling beats frantic pulling.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade, pick a game and play it through to the end — any of them counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of missions — keep taking his jobs until the last one appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a chain of jobs — follow it through to the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a chain of missions — keep taking his jobs until the final one appears.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers around the state — take each one's jobs until its strand ends, and keep an eye out in every area.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a chain of jobs — follow it through to the last one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a chain of jobs — keep taking them until the final one appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots — visit each one and meditate; they are scattered across the state, so check them off as you explore.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 18-spot count via PSNProfiles. Spot locations not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a single quarry — follow his lead, track it down and take the shot.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. The animal's location is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets, three of them, and keep a note of which cards you still need.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Card locations not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a spray-tag activity — tag 100 spots across the state, working area by area so none is missed.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Tag spots not yet mapped.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — they stack up across missions, activities and free roam, so keep an eye on the challenge list and finish 50 of them.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level — build the heat with them, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it drops. Do it while your partner is available, before the story moves on: flagged missable from the description.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — plan a route through three close shops and move fast. Do it while your partner is available: flagged missable from the description.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts — try everything you find, from scooters to trucks, and the count climbs as you explore.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends — a crowded shootout is the place for it.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule did not plan — a runway dash or a stolen aircraft on the tarmac. It reads like a one-time moment at one place, so try it the first time you are at VCIA: flagged missable from the description.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks — steal one, destroy one, or survive one — and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan the escape before the robbery, not after.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, crack it open and get away before the law closes in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas — drive, fly or walk through every one until the map is full.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 52-area count via PSNProfiles. Area boundaries not yet mapped.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — hit one illegal operation for each of them.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 9-gang count via PSNProfiles. Gang operation locations not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom's frontage and out the other side.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates alley and see it through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partnership moment that lands with the crowd — play the story with your partner and it comes.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — the story's choices add up, and some can only be made once. Make your choices deliberately, and know that a different choice needs another playthrough: flagged missable from the description.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; count via PSNProfiles. Which choices count is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy rewards the comeback, not the first try.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a one-off event somewhere in Leonida. Keep your eyes open in free roam; it finds you as much as you find it.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. The event is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — line up the pass, swing, and keep driving.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase. Method not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts and the clean money adds up to $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent is money spent — clothes, cars, weapons and food all count toward the $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties — buy every one of them.
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; 8-property count via PSNProfiles. Property locations not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles, register each one in the Scooter Bros app, and the count is done.
